scenes.line1: Why do Spring Boot apps need less setup?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why Spring Boot projects need so little manual setup? How does auto-configuration make it happen?

scenes.label: Starters
scenes.sub: Starters bundle dependencies for web, data, or other features.
scenes.say: Spring Boot starters are bundles of dependencies for features like web or data. They make adding functionality fast and easy.
Auto-configuration scans your project for libraries, checks your settings, and sets up only what you need. No extra code required.
Profiles let you switch between environments easily. Each profile can have its own config file for clean separation.

scenes.question: Can you skip config files in prod?
scenes.right: No, you still need profile-specific files for production settings.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Can you skip config files in production? No, you still need separate files for each environment.
